project.name: Selemene TUI / RHDUI — Platform Integration Build
assumptions: Selemene API (v3.0.0) is stable and deployed on Railway — no API changes needed
All 16 engines and 6 workflows are live and responding
bridges/cli exists as scaffold; TUI will extend or replace it
Tauri, Raycast, and Apple ecosystem work are greenfield
Ratatui (Rust) is the TUI framework; Ink (React) considered but passed over for consistency
macOS menu bar applet uses SwiftUI + MenuBarExtra
Apple Watch uses WatchKit / SwiftUI complications
Tauri wrapper uses Tauri v2 + React/Svelte frontend
Apple Shortcuts use HTTP actions calling the live API
birth_data profile is stored locally as JSON (TUI) and in Keychain (macOS/watchOS)
risks: Apple Watch payload size limits may restrict multi-engine workflows
Raycast extension review process adds unknown delay
Tauri v2 is relatively new; may hit edge cases on macOS Sequoia
Keychain access from Shortcuts requires entitlements
Menu bar + Raycast must respond in <2s; slow engines need prefetch/cache
WatchOS connectivity constraints require robust offline caching

parallel_execution_strategy.description: Tasks marked with parallel_group can be dispatched to independent Claude agents simultaneously using dispatching-parallel-agents. Each agent gets a focused scope, clear deliverable, and constraint to not modify code outside its domain.
parallel_execution_strategy.dispatch_pattern: One agent per task within a parallel_group. Agent prompt includes: task title, acceptance criteria, files to touch, and constraint boundaries.
parallel_execution_strategy.integration_step: After parallel agents return, a single integration pass reviews all changes, runs tests, and resolves any conflicts.

parallel_dispatch_manifest.description: Groups of tasks that can be dispatched to independent Claude agents simultaneously. Use dispatching-parallel-agents pattern: one agent per task, focused prompt, no shared state.

groups.constraint: Each agent works in its own module within noesis-sdk; no cross-module imports until integration
Each agent implements one screen in noesis-tui; both depend on shared app shell but don't touch it
Each agent adds one export format; output to separate files
Each agent works on independent UI concerns (help, errors, profile edit)
Scaffold and preferences are independent setup tasks
Each agent implements one Raycast command; all share the API client but don't modify it
Scaffold, API client, and Keychain are independent modules
Each agent builds one popover section; no shared UI state
Each agent builds one page/route in the Tauri React app; shared components read-only
Each agent builds one Shortcut file; no shared code
Scaffold and WatchConnectivity are independent modules
Each agent builds one watch view or complication; shared models read-only
Cache layer and prefetch scheduler are independent modules within noesis-sdk
Each agent tests one surface; no shared test state
Each agent writes different docs; no file overlap
